summary.text: Ashley Hinson is the Republican nominee and the U.S. Representative for Iowa's 2nd Congressional District, first elected in 2020. A former KCRG-TV anchor and reporter in Cedar Rapids, she served in the Iowa House from 2017 before running for Congress. She is running for the open seat of retiring Sen. Joni Ernst (R) and has Ernst's endorsement.

paragraphs.text: Born in Des Moines, Iowa, in 1983; lives in Marion, Iowa. Wikipedia reports she graduated from Valley High School in West Des Moines.
Earned a B.A. in broadcast journalism from the University of Southern California.

Worked as a news anchor and reporter at KCRG-TV in Cedar Rapids for more than a decade, winning two regional Emmy awards and recognition as an RTDNA Health Reporting Fellow, according to her House website.
Has served with organizations including the Cedar Rapids Metro Economic Alliance, March of Dimes and Junior Achievement of Eastern Iowa, according to Ballotpedia.

Elected to the Iowa House of Representatives (District 67, Linn County) in 2016 and re-elected in 2018, serving from 2017 until she took her U.S. House seat; she chaired the Transportation Committee and served on Judiciary and Public Safety, according to Wikipedia.

Won the 2020 Republican primary and then the general election for Iowa's 1st District over Rep. Abby Finkenauer (51.2% to 48.6%); after redistricting she ran in and won the 2nd District in 2022, and was re-elected in 2024.

Serves on the House Appropriations Committee and the Select Committee on the Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party, and, per Ballotpedia, the Ethics Committee in the 2025-2026 Congress.
Her House website says she and her husband, Matt, are raising two sons in Marion and that she plays violin at Antioch Christian Church.
